benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Accor Plus membership has been added, which could be quite helpful for travellers. The card already offers Taj Epicure membership, providing benefits with Taj Group properties, along with Accor Plus membership, thus allowing the frequent travellers to save on their hotel stays. Moreover, both domestic and international lounge access with a Priority Pass membership further lets consumers travel in comfort. The card’s monthly milestone benefit of Rs. 1,000 enhances its overall value-back, despite the Rs. 50,000 spending requirement. For high spenders, meeting this threshold shouldn’t be a challenge, thus allowing them to earn benefits worth Rs. 12,000 annually. These monthly spends will also unlock the golf benefits for the cardholders. However, the card’s poor reward rate is a major drawback. Cardholders would be able to get good additional benefits, but the core value-back through rewards would be much lower compared to what you could get with other premium cards like HDFC Diners Club Black, ICICI Emeralde Private, or even with certain lower-fee options like Axis Atlas.

faqs.q: Does American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card offer purchase protection?
faqs.a: Yes, being a premium credit card it offers purchase protection. You can get a refund for any item that is stolen due to burglary or damages or breaks due to fire, earthquake, flood, storm, cyclone, etc., within 60 days of purchase.

faqs.q: Can I convert my American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card purchases into EMI?
faqs.a: Yes, you can convert your purchases of Rs. 5,000 or above into easy EMI. To avail this facility at the time of purchase, you can ask the merchant to convert the entire transaction into EMI.

faqs.q: Can I earn reward points on fuel transactions via American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card?
faqs.a: No, you do not earn any points on fuel spends. However, you can avail fuel convenience fee waiver on your fuel expenses at HPCL petrol pumps. You can get a 0% and 1% convenience fee on your fuel transactions of up to Rs. 5,000 and above Rs. 5,000, respectively.

faqs.q: How can I redeem the reward points earned via American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can redeem your Membership Rewards Points earned via this credit card against a variety of categories, such as travel, dining, accessories and more by logging in to your rewards account. Apart from this, you can also use your earned reward points to pay for your card charges, which is an added advantage.

faqs.q: Does American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card offer lost card liability?
faqs.a: Yes, you can claim the lost card liability by reporting the loss or fraud within 3 working days to the American Express customer care. If the fraud is reported beyond 3 working days, then you will get a maximum liability of Rs. 1,000. Therefore, it is important to report the fraud as soon as possible to make the most out of this benefit.

faqs.q: How can I apply for American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply for this credit card online through the official website of American Express. All you need to do is look for the required card as per its eligibility and fill out the application form. You are also required to submit relevant documents for verification. The bank will then verify your details and process your request.

faqs.question: Is the American Express Platinum Reserve Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining fee is ₹10,000 + GST and the annual fee is ₹10,000 + GST. The annual fee is waived when you spend ₹10 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the American Express Platinum Reserve Credit Card?
faqs.answer: It's 3.5% plus GST on spends in a foreign currency. That's the usual rate, so it isn't the best card to use abroad.

faqs.question: Does the American Express Platinum Reserve Credit Card give airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 3 domestic visits a quarter, plus 2 international visits a year.

faqs.question: How much can I earn with the American Express Platinum Reserve Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn about 1% back as cashback on regular spends, and up to 2% on its bonus categories. Check the review above for the exact categories and monthly caps.

program_updates_2026: New Applications Paused: American Express has temporarily paused new card applications in India (existing cardholders unaffected).
From 15 November 2026: Amex counts monthly milestone transactions by posting date (not transaction date) and keeps MR pools separate per card.
Transfer Partners Updated (Aug–Nov 2026): Hilton Honors improved to 1:1.5 (1,000:1,500), Virgin Atlantic improved to 5:4 (800:640), Etihad Guest removed 1 July 2026, Emirates Skywards suspended.
Note: Since the Platinum Reserve doesn’t earn regular MR points on fuel or utilities, these monthly vouchers are the only way to get a “return” on those specific spends.

Important Note: One major drawback to keep in mind is that the Platinum Reserve does not currently offer access to the exclusive American Express Centurion Lounges. This benefit was removed in 2023 and has not yet been reinstated, leaving those lounges reserved for Platinum Charge and Centurion cardholders only.
